          Unveil Alexandria: Where Ancient Wonders Meet Mediterranean Breezes

          Feel the timeless allure of the Mediterranean where history breathes through coastal winds. Alexandria welcomes you with an open heart and a vibrant coastal energy, seamlessly bridging legendary marvels with contemporary charm. Walk along the historic shores, uncover layers of captivating heritage, and let the refreshing sea breeze elevate your journey. Your unforgettable Egyptian adventure begins in this luminous seaside jewel.


          1. Discover The Bibliotheca Alexandrina

          Immerse yourself in knowledge at this stunning, modern tribute to the legendary ancient library. The magnificent architecture captures the imagination, offering open learning spaces and brilliant cultural exhibits.


          2. Explore The Citadel Of Qaitbay

          Walk through the historic stone ramparts of this 15th-century fortress boasting spectacular Mediterranean views. Stand where an ancient wonder once stood and feel the powerful maritime legacy of the coast.


          3. Descend Into Kom El Shoqafa

          Step back in time to explore these fascinating, multi-level ancient Roman catacombs. Marvel at the unique fusion of historic artistic styles carved deep into the rock centuries ago.


          4. Wander The Alexandria Corniche

          Feel the refreshing sea breeze as you stroll along the scenic waterfront boulevard. Enjoy the lively local rhythm, brilliant horizons, and welcoming cafes that line the beautiful coast.


          5. Visit The Roman Amphitheater

          Uncover history at Alexandria’s beautifully preserved ancient theater and archaeological site. View the marble terraces where audiences once gathered and experience the city's enduring passion for culture.
